name: ewake
description: Ask Gemini CLI about production: why an incident started, which team owns a service, what changed before it failed. Ewake answers from your service map, past investigations and deployments. The skills also report deployments and map the services of a repository.

settings.name: Ewake host
settings.description: Enter the host name of your Ewake dashboard, without https:// and without /mcp. Example: your-company.ewake.ai
